title: What is the current meta for developing games with AI?
author: Bitter-College8786
selftext:
This infographic is just there to pull people into reading what I am asking.

Is there some kind of a meta when you develop games with AI agents?  
Like which engine to use? Which 3D generation tools etc.?

replies.author: Disastrous-Round-150
replies.body:
The title is drawn entirely in GLSL using numbers and mathematical shapes:

* **Letters:** Each character is encoded as a **5×5 grid**. Active cells become small SDF boxes that join into solid block lettering.
* **Words:** The shader spaces and centers those letters to form **BEYOND**, **THE**, and **BLITTER**.
* **Animation:** A **144 BPM clock** cycles through the three words and the stacked title, adding sideways slides, vertical bounce, shear, and zoom.
* **Appearance:** The text shape acts as a mask for moving patterns and colors. Offset copies create shadows and outlines, while softened distance thresholds smooth the edges.

No external fonts, images, or textures are needed.

Thank you! ❤️ 

I don't really work with other people I got ADHD like crazy and love to spam tons of different small AI projects each day working on 10 different projects at the same time. But I don't like spending huge amounts of time on one big project like what you're suggesting.

But with procedural gen you only need to be 1 person really, just as a pure test I tried to replicate a game demo which someone spent 1 week non-stop making with game engines and blender in Claude Opus 5.5. With just using a video as reference material and a prompt I one shot the same thing in GPT 6 Astra in about 30-40 mins. I won't say it was 100% as polished as what he created but damn close.🔥

comments.author: matthewjosephtaylor
comments.body:
Use AI as a teacher to learn the various aspects of gamedev one is interested in exploring/exploiting.  
  
Tools are useful means to an end. They constantly change, and change too fast currently to get comfortable with any, as the build/buy decision is too fluid as AI eats the world. Just point the AI at some toolset and let it decide/decide together what fits your goals best today. Tomorrow it will change.

I don't think there is one 'meta' for AI/gamedev as we are all individually playing different games. :)
